description: This is a JUnit 5 test class for the EmailServiceImpl in a Spring Boot application, testing email sending functionalities including simple message and Thymeleaf template-based messages using GreenMail for testing SMTP interactions.

classes.name: EmailServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying email sending functionalities of EmailServiceImpl, including sending simple messages and messages with Thymeleaf templates.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test variables and the email service instance before each test.

methods.name: GivenRecipientSubjectBody_WhenSendSimpleMessage_ThenSendMessage
methods.description: Tests sending a simple email message and verifies its content and recipients.

methods.name: GivenRecipientSubjectBody_WhenSendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate_ThenSendMessage
methods.description: Tests sending an email using a Thymeleaf template and verifies its content and recipients.
